title: Learn Networking
tagline: From packets and subnets to resilient enterprise networks
description: A three-level curriculum for network engineers — designing addressing and routing, operating switching/Wi‑Fi/firewalls, and building observable, secure networks that scale with the business.
prerequisites: Comfort with binary/hex at a basic level (or willingness to learn)
Familiarity with how apps use TCP/IP (browsers, APIs)
Access to a lab (physical gear, GNS3/EVE-NG, or cloud VPCs)
tools: Firewall platforms (pfSense / Palo Alto / cloud NGFW)

levels.title: Networking Foundations
levels.goal: Understand the TCP/IP model, address networks, and troubleshoot Layer 2/3 connectivity

topics.title: TCP/IP essentials
items: Ethernet, MAC, ARP, and VLANs at a conceptual level
TCP vs. UDP, ports, and three-way handshake

topics.title: IPv4 addressing
items: Designing a small site addressing plan

topics.title: L2 switching
items: Basic switch config and show commands

topics.title: Static routing
items: Host routing tables (ip route / route print)

projects: Subnet plan for a small office (users, servers, guests, management)
Lab: VLANs + inter-VLAN routing with verified ping paths
Wireshark capture analysis of a failed DNS or TLS handshake
Connectivity runbook for “can’t reach the app” tickets

levels.title: Enterprise Network Operations
levels.goal: Operate routed campuses, Wi‑Fi, firewalls, and DNS/DHCP with change discipline

topics.title: IGP fundamentals
items: OSPF areas and neighbor states at a working level

topics.title: Firewalls & ACLs
items: Change windows and rollback for rule pushes

projects: OSPF (or equivalent) lab with failover demonstration
Firewall rule set for a three-tier app with documented intent
Wi‑Fi design notes for a floor (channels, density, SSIDs)
NetBox (or spreadsheet IPAM) model of a lab network

levels.title: Network Architecture & Reliability
levels.goal: Design scalable, observable, secure networks and lead complex changes

topics.title: Observability
items: SLO-style availability for paths and VPN hubs
Correlating app latency with network path issues

topics.title: Automation & change
items: Config as code and peer-reviewed changes

projects: Network design doc for a new office or DC pod
BGP lab with prefix filters and failover
Telemetry dashboard + alert set for critical links
Change automation PoC (template + review + push to lab)
